items.claim: [r42-1] fit guards measure a stroke's halo as half the halo width
items.note: This also moved the marked crosshair's offset from 3 to 2 units, so its arms' halo now fits in the box.

items.claim: [r42-2] a marked glyph takes an angle but is never checked for rotation
items.note: My call, recorded in `docs/unruled.md`: `resolveCursor` paints such a spec, and `bakeCursor`/`cursorFor` throw a `RangeError` unless the new `clip: true` is passed.

items.claim: [r42-3] the bake cache's key takes any size and fallback, so it is unbounded
items.note: The cache now keeps the 256 most recently used cursors.

items.claim: [r42-4] the path walk accepts absolute H, V, C, Q, S and T
items.note: (no longer applies). `walk` throws for anything outside M/L/A/Z, it is tested in `types.test.ts`, and the pending changeset `cursor-fit-guard-dialect.md` covers it.

items.claim: [r42-5] the arc bound uses the authored radius when SVG scales it up
[r42-6] markedGlyph drops the glyph's own `over` layer
[r42-7] a world brush ring of radius 0 draws at the 24 px default
items.note: My call, recorded in `docs/unruled.md`: it now draws the one-pixel ring that `brushRing(0)` draws.

items.claim: rotation fit bounded an arc by its circle's bounding square rather than by the circle
items.note: folded into r42-1. With the corrected stroke margins, the old bound would have wrongly rejected the `rotate` glyph.
